grammar.topic: because of, therefore, as a result
explainTr: 'Because' arkasından tam cümle ister: because it rained. 'Because of' arkasından isim ister: because of the rain. İkisi de 'çünkü / yüzünden' anlamında, fark yapıdadır.
'Therefore' ve 'as a result' sonucu anlatır ve genellikle yeni bir cümlenin başında, virgülle gelir: It rained. Therefore, the trip was canceled.
'As a result of' + isim de olur: As a result of the storm, school closed. Yazıda ve resmi e-postalarda çok işe yarar.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'yüzünden / bu yüzden / sonuç olarak' farklı eklerle ve kelimelerle gelir. İngilizcede 'çünkü' için isim mi cümle mi geldiğine bakarsın: because + cümle, because of + isim. Sonuç için de cümle başında Therefore, / As a result, yazılır.

reading.title: A message from the principal
reading.text:
Last Monday, Hafsa received an email from Lincoln Elementary. The principal, Ms. Rivera, announced several decisions for the new month.

First, the zoo field trip is postponed until May because of the bad weather forecast. The roads are icy, and the district worries about safety. Therefore, all school buses will stay at school this week.

Second, the school board approved a new policy. Students must wear their ID cards in the hallway. As a result of this rule, visitors and substitute teachers will also need a badge from the front office. Hafsa thought the policy was reasonable because it protects the children.

Third, there is a budget problem. The school has a shortage of paper and markers, so the principal decided to reduce the number of copies each teacher can make. She also wants to increase the number of parent volunteers. Some teachers were unhappy about the change, but Ms. Rivera explained her reasons clearly. "We must use our money carefully," she wrote. "Every decision has consequences."

Hafsa read the email twice. The writing was clear and easy to follow. She did not agree with everything, but she understood the reasons. Because of these changes, she decided to ask Mr. Brown about a volunteer badge the next day.

questions.q: Why is the zoo trip postponed?
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'postponed until May because of the bad weather forecast'.

options: A badge from the front office

Metin: 'reduce the number of copies each teacher can make'.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Good morning, Hafsa. Did you read the principal's email?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Yes, I did. The field trip is postponed. Why exactly?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Because of the ice. The roads are dangerous, so the district canceled all buses.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: That makes sense. And the new badge rule?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: The school board approved it last week. As a result, every visitor must sign in and wear a badge.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Do substitute teachers need one too?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Yes. You need a photo, and you must show your ID. It takes five minutes.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: No, it is free. The school allows volunteers to get one too.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Good. Because of the budget, I thought everything costs money now.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Not this time! Come back on Thursday at nine, and I will have it ready.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Thursday at nine. Thank you, Mr. Brown.

writing.promptTr: Okulunda (veya iş yerinde) alınan bir kararı ve nedenlerini anlat. because of, therefore, as a result kullan (80-100 kelime).
writing.promptEn: Describe a decision at a school or workplace and its reasons. Use because of, therefore and as a result (80-100 words).
frames: I think this decision is ... because ...
writing.model: Last week our school announced a new rule. Because of safety problems, students cannot leave the building during lunch. The principal said that some children left without permission. Therefore, the front office now checks every student at the door. As a result, the hallways are quieter and safer. Some parents are unhappy because of the change, but I think the policy is reasonable. It protects the children, and it costs nothing. I hope the school will approve a small outdoor play area soon, because children need fresh air during the day.
checklistTr: 'Because of' sonrasında isim kullandın mı, 'because' sonrasında cümle mi?
'Therefore,' veya 'As a result,' cümlenin başında ve virgüllü mü?
Bir neden ve bir sonuç net olarak yazıldı mı?
Cümleler büyük harfle başlıyor ve noktayla bitiyor mu?
